sops.name: Conduct Professional Boundaries & Digital Devices
sops.notes: Gap 1: Code of Conduct sign-off is bundled inside this SOP rather than a standalone acknowledgement. Gap 2: no re-acknowledgement trigger when the Code is updated. Action: split Code of Conduct acknowledgement into its own standalone, versioned sign-off.

sops.name: Engagement with the Program and Practice Expectations
Raising Concerns Hazards & Practice Issues
sops.notes: Staff-facing only. Family-facing complaints SOP is missing, see Section 2.

sops.name: Sleep Rest & Quiet Supervision
sops.notes: Recommend upgrading sign-off to supervisor-verified: safe sleep is a high-consequence practical skill.

sops.name: Medication Handling and Administration
sops.notes: Recommend upgrading sign-off to supervisor-verified: high-consequence practical skill.

sops.name: Outdoor Play Safety & Risk
sops.notes: Four policies collapsed into one SOP. UV Sun Safety and Water Safety need breaking out into their own SOPs, see Section 2.

sops.name: Cultural Partnerships
sops.notes: Rolled out 17 August 2026, still in progress.

sops.name: Inclusion & Fair Access in Daily Practice
Psychosocial Hazard Identification and Review
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. OHS Psychological Health Regulations 2025 in force since 1 Dec 2025. Needs a documented risk assessment and review cycle, not just a statement.

sops.name: Responding to and Preventing Sexual Harassment
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Positive duty expands under the Fair Work Act from October 2026 and covers third parties including parents and visitors.

sops.name: Staff Grievance and Dispute Resolution
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. No staff-facing equivalent to the family complaints process currently exists.

sops.name: Bullying and Harassment - Staff to Staff
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Distinct from the Code of Conduct. This is what a Fair Work anti-bullying application tests against.

sops.name: Bushfire Response
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Policy exists, no SOP translates it into staff actions. High consequence for regional sites.

sops.name: Managing an Aggressive Person or Visitor
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Also directly serves the psychosocial hazard duty, aggression is a named hazard.

sops.name: Anaphylaxis Response
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Currently folded into the medication SOP. High consequence, warrants its own SOP and observed competency.

sops.name: Bottle and Breast Milk Preparation
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Becomes critical with the Timboon baby room opening.

sops.name: Child Protection and Reportable Conduct - Educator Level
sops.notes: PRIORITY 1. Currently exists at leadership tier only. Every educator is a mandatory reporter and needs their own SOP.

sops.name: Manual Handling
sops.notes: Training already delivered face-to-face by directors, but no policy or SOP captures it and there is no sign-off record. Cheapest gap to close: the work is already done, it just needs documenting. Build the sign-off record retrospectively from director attendance records.

sops.name: Adverse Weather Response
sops.notes: PRIORITY 2.

sops.name: Site Emergency and Disaster Response
sops.notes: PRIORITY 2. Site-specific. Separate from the existing evacuation and lockdown SOP.

sops.name: Students Volunteers and Visitors
sops.notes: PRIORITY 2. Ties to Child Safe Standards: who supervises non-staff adults on site.

sops.name: Handling a Family Complaint
sops.notes: PRIORITY 2. Existing SOP covers staff raising concerns, not staff receiving a family complaint.

sops.name: UV and Sun Safety
sops.notes: PRIORITY 3. Currently folded into Outdoor Play Safety & Risk.

sops.name: Water Safety
sops.notes: PRIORITY 3. Currently folded into Outdoor Play Safety & Risk.

sops.name: Right to Disconnect
sops.notes: PRIORITY 3. Newest NES entitlement.

sops.name: SOP 1: Curriculum and Program Oversight
sops.notes: EYLF/VEYLDF alignment; weekly program review + walkthroughs.

sops.name: SOP 2: Assessment and Planning Cycle Quality
